label: Rival: something altogether IMMUTABLE_1 is not ETERNAL_1 (everlasting in time)
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by the view that time passes without change and by accounts of an everlasting God who is in time: something in potency in no respect is not eternal. The replacement account of its duration is everlasting existence in time; the formal statement has only the predicate for timeless eternity and expresses only its failure, not temporal duration. It is the exact negation of STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-ETERNAL on the same carrier. It does not say that such a thing begins or ends.
